newsitem.title: FINLAND: Majority of Finns see Finland in EMU in 1999 - poll.
newsitem.headline: Majority of Finns see Finland in EMU in 1999 - poll.

text.p: A clear majority of Finns expect their country to join the third stage of European economic and monetary union (EMU) from the start in January 1999, according to a poll by a pro-EU association, Eurooppalainen Suomi.

Of 1,003 respondents polled by telephone between May 27 and June 3 by research institute Taloustutkimus, 78 percent believed Finland would join EMU from the start, while 12 percent did not expect Finland to join and 10 percent were undecided, it said.
Among supporters of the five parties in the pro-EMU government coalition, 87 percent saw Finland among the single currency's founding members.
Over 70 percent of opposition parties' supporters said they were rather sure Finland would be among the first to join. Most opposition parties are against Finnish EMU membership.
The association's statement did not say whether those polled had also been asked whether they thought Finland should join EMU.
